name: BHUSD Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / BHUSD Committee
  Will conduct a Special Meeting at the following time and place, and will address the
  agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  Municipal Gallery
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  IN-PERSON / TELEPHONIC / VIDEO CONFERENCE MEETING

  Beverly Hills Liaison Meeting
  https://beverlyhills-org.zoom.us/my/committee
  Meeting ID: 516 191 2424
  Passcode: 90210

  MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, September 21, 2023
  11:05 AM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  September 21, 2023 / 11:05 a .m.

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian A. Gold, Councilmember Lili Bosse; Ryan Gohlich, Assistant
  City Manager, Stephanie Harris, Director of Community Services, Patty
  Acuna, Assistant Director of Community Services; Dr. Michael Bregy,
  Superintendent of Schools; Raphael Guzman, Assistant Superintendent;
  Noah Margo, BHUSD Board President, Tim Ellis, Executive Director
  Athletics/JPA; Mary Wells, BHUSD Board Clerk; Mark Mead, Executive
  Director School Safety, Mark Stainbrook, Chief of Police; David Schirmer,
  Chief Information Officer; Matthew Brown, Recreation Services Manager,
  Adrine Ovasapyan, Recreation Services Manager, Joana Torres,
  Community Services Manager, Linda Kyriazi, Recording Secretary

  1) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item listed on the agenda.
  None.

  2) JPA Agreement / Negotiations
  Patty Acuna, Assistant Director of Community Services, welcomed and thanked the JPA
  working group and presented a final version of the agreement for approval by both the
  City of Beverly Hills and the Beverly Hills Unified School District.
  - What is the JPA?
  - New to the JPA Agreement.
  - Timeline
   -  JPA Financials
  -  City Use and Benefits of the JPA

  Noah Margo, BHUSD Board President, reviewed a few minor corrections in the
  agreement.

  Mayor Gold and Council Member Lili Bosse requested not putting a time on any
  facility/school. The understanding will be if we programmed a facility and we want to move
  that function to a different facility, we will have a conversation about what it takes to make
  that happen.

  Dr. Michael Bregy, Superintendent of Schools, requested that it was clear in the
  agreement that the CCTV Camera are not restricted to the number of views and that it is
  a not to exceed $1.9 million for the purchase and installation of cameras.

  David Schirmer, Chief Information Officer, cleared up the terminology. Indicating that,
  BHUSD has the specific locations of the cameras and that determines the cost associated.
  If they are interior cameras or street cameras, that would change the cost of each. They
  could then go back and do more refine calculations so the views could potentially increase
  but the dollar amount could remain the same.

  Patty Acuna, Assistant Director of Community Services, provided an updated on the
  Pickleball schedule and future plans for the court at Beverly Hills High School.

  The agreement will be active immediately but the Pickleball court will be created and
  established at the end of the 23/24 school year.

  The JPA Agreement will go forward to the City Council for approval on October 3, 2023.

  3) Adjournment

ADJOURNMENT
